item.description: A developer built a real-time FIFA World Cup 2026 app—live scores, knockout brackets, head-to-head stats, venue maps, and match predictions—almost entirely by conversing with Cortex Code Desktop (CoCo), with no boilerplate code. It manages thousands of cloud resources and is not open source.

item.description: Recent Microsoft and Amazon earnings calls give a common signal: Arm-based custom CPUs are now core to hyperscale cloud infrastructure. Microsoft expects Azure Cobalt 200 racks in over 25 data centers by end of July; Amazon's chip business hit $25B annualized revenue with triple-digit growth, and Graviton5 adoption is nearly double Graviton4's pace. Nadella framed it as 'CPU is as important as GPU when running agent workloads.'
